scope: Three exact T24.12 criteria and their changed-condition reference support; no other T24 leaf or independent attempt is closed

ordinary.claim: Actual current operation probe and T62 raw-ring import; ordinary pipe cancellation, separate target/cancel CQEs, stale cancel, delayed dispatch, short read/EOF/badfd and five acquisition cuts;720 event permutations

changed.claim: Actual registered buffers/subrange17 and invalid range, target-plus-cancel drain then synchronous unregister before unmap; registered blocked-read cancellation

ordinary.claim: Equivalent original file/socket bytes through copy/sendfile/ordinary-ring/fixed-ring; raw allocation, retained-byte, pin-interval, mapping/stack/import evidence and independent byte oracle

changed.claim: Actual stalled copy/sendfile sockets reach EAGAIN, retain immutable file until verified prefix/EOF; observed cancellation-to-drain samples and conditional bound analysis

ordinary.claim: Two optimized compilers × four backends × two depths × two cache snapshots × two workload shapes × three trials; full64 latency samples/cell, whole/setup/workload/processCPU, cleanup and disclosed pilot-informed seal

changed.claim: Small scattered64-byte versus sequential4096-byte request generator, independent result oracle and pre-matrix prediction; no universal speed or physical-cache claim

updates.closure_rationale: Actual current operation probe and T62 raw-ring import; ordinary pipe cancellation, separate target/cancel CQEs, stale cancel, delayed dispatch, short read/EOF/badfd and five acquisition cuts;720 event permutations

physical_observation.state: not-observed; local hosted Linux execution only

updates.required_environment: Hosted C17 GCC/Clang Linux x86-64 with actual T62 io_uring, operation probe and an owned guest filesystem supporting the measured cache snapshots; no liburing, host policy change or external traffic.
updates.validation_method: Actual ordinary/registered read/cancel modes and acquisition cuts, independent event sets and byte oracle, equivalent192-cell workload matrix, stalled copy/sendfile, compiled semantic controls and real learner export.
evidence_limits: Bounded Linux/toolchain experiments; no physical target claim.
A successful reference run does not establish independent learner performance.
Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
